description.p: 4nec2 models and analyzes antennas using NEC. It provides geometry editing, radiation patterns, frequency sweeps and optimization.

This community package downloads the official Windows installer and runs it unmodified under Wine. Cellar installs it into a private persistent Wine prefix on first launch. The package also stages the installer’s DirectX 8 library in that prefix for the 3D viewer. Wine is a separate dependency; install it with flatpak install flathub org.winehq.Wine//stable-26.08.

Windows file dialogs show your accessible home folders on drive H:. Browse to Documents to open models or save output. To allow another folder, run flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/models net.qsl._4nec2. Undo overrides with flatpak override --user --reset net.qsl._4nec2.
The interface follows your desktop scale by default. If the text or controls are too small, choose a larger size. Restart 4nec2 after changing the setting.

ul.li: Example for larger text and controls: flatpak run --command=cellar net.qsl._4nec2 config dpi=168
Restore automatic scaling: flatpak run --command=cellar net.qsl._4nec2 config dpi=auto
